targets.old_statement: Outsiders yield to procession vehicles and must not split, join for advantage, pass on the right, or cross its path through red.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Outsiders yield to procession vehicles and must not split, join for advantage, pass on the right, or cross its path through red.
targets.statement: Drivers outside a funeral procession must yield to it and may not cut between moving procession vehicles unless police-authorized or driving an emergency vehicle, join to gain its right-of-way, pass it on the right on a multi-lane highway unless it occupies the farthest left lane, or enter an intersection on red unless doing so without crossing its path.
